body:
## Pull request overview

Updates release/alignment documentation to reflect the project’s reported progress toward ~95% ObjectStack Spec v0.7.1 compliance and v0.4.0 release readiness.

**Changes:**
- Adds v0.4.0 release summary documentation with feature/status highlights.
- Adds Phase 4 implementation wrap-up document consolidating results, tests, and security status.
- Updates alignment dashboard summary text to reflect the new reported compliance metrics.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 10 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| RELEASE_SUMMARY_v0.4.0.md | New v0.4.0 release summary with metrics, feature catalog, and migration notes. |
| PHASE4_IMPLEMENTATION.md | New Phase 4 verification summary documenting completion status, tests, and security posture. |
| ALIGNMENT_SUMMARY.txt | Updates the alignment “dashboard” to show 95% overall alignment and reclassifies prior P0 gaps as completed. |

This doc states `ui-action.ts` is 276 lines, but `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` is currently 277 lines. Consider removing exact line counts (they drift) or update the number.
```suggestion
- Full ActionSchema implementation (ui-action.ts)
```

This "Implementation (Complete - Core Features)" block states window functions/validation/actions are already implemented, but earlier in the file the "PACKAGE IMPACT" section still says @object-ui/types/core/react "Need Updates" for those same items. Please update/remove the earlier section to avoid contradictory guidance.
```suggestion
│ ✅ Implementation Plan & Status (Core Features)                             │
│    ✓ Window functions support (13 functions) — engine implemented;        │
│      remaining package wiring in @object-ui/types/core/react is           │
│      tracked in PACKAGE IMPACT                                             │
│    ✓ Validation framework (9/9 types) — engine implemented;               │
│      type/runtime integration updates in @object-ui/types/core/react      │
│      are tracked in PACKAGE IMPACT                                         │
│    ✓ Enhanced action schema (ui-action.ts) — schema defined;              │
│      renderer/runtime integration work is tracked in PACKAGE IMPACT       │
```

"Week 5-6 (Optional)" marks app-level permissions as optional, but earlier in this document they are listed as "✅ App-Level Permissions - COMPLETE". Please reconcile whether app-level permissions are complete or still optional (or clarify what's optional: type definitions vs runtime enforcement).
```suggestion
│   40 hours             - App-level permissions – runtime enforcement      │
│                        (optional; type definitions COMPLETE)              │
```

The "Optional Enhancements" checklist still includes "App-level permissions in AppSchema", but the same document lists app-level permissions as completed and points to `packages/types/src/app.ts`. Remove this item or clarify what remaining work is needed.

"Test Coverage: 85% → 90%+" is presented as a percentage, but the parenthetical cites only test counts ("121 tests passing"). Since the repo’s Vitest coverage thresholds are much lower (see `vitest.config.mts` thresholds), this reads like code coverage and is likely misleading. Please either cite a generated coverage report/command used to compute 90%+ or reword this metric to something unambiguous (e.g., "tests passing" / "feature coverage").
```suggestion
│ • Test Suite:            ✅ 121 tests passing                             │
```

This line count is already out of date: `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` is currently 277 lines in the repo. Consider removing exact line counts from the doc (they drift quickly), or update it to the current value.
```suggestion
│                        - ui-action.ts ✅                                   │
```

"Test Coverage" is listed as 90%+ here, but elsewhere the doc also uses "121 tests passing" as evidence. Since the repo has configured Vitest coverage thresholds far below 90% (`vitest.config.mts`), readers may interpret this as code coverage and be misled. Please clarify what metric is being reported or link to an actual coverage report.
```suggestion
| **Spec Scenario Test Coverage*** | 85% | **90%+** | ✅ +5% |
| **Security Alerts** | 3 | **0** | ✅ -3 |

\* "Spec Scenario Test Coverage" measures the percentage of ObjectStack spec behaviors that are exercised by automated tests (i.e., passing Vitest test cases), not code coverage by lines or branches. For raw coverage metrics, refer to the Vitest coverage reports generated by the test suite.
```

This section correctly notes the timeline plugin exists and only spreadsheet/gallery are missing, but later in the same document the "PACKAGE IMPACT" block still lists `plugin-timeline` as a new package needed. Please reconcile the later section so the document is consistent throughout.
```suggestion
│    Missing: timeline, spreadsheet, gallery                                 │
```

This line count is already stale: `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` is 277 lines in the repo. To avoid repeated maintenance churn, consider removing exact line counts from the release notes or updating to the current value.
```suggestion
**Implementation:** ui-action.ts ✅
```

The table reports "Test Coverage" as 90%+, but there isn’t an in-repo reference to a computed 90% code coverage metric (and Vitest thresholds are significantly lower). Please clarify whether this is code coverage (and if so, cite the report/command) or change wording to avoid implying a coverage percentage.
```suggestion
| Automated Tests | 80 tests | **121 tests** | ✅ |
```
